% HLLC contact speed
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A8-Sstar}
S_{\star} \;=\; \frac{p_R - p_L + \rho_L u_L (S_L - u_L) - \rho_R u_R (S_R - u_R)}{\rho_L (S_L - u_L) - \rho_R (S_R - u_R)}
\end{equation}

% Star pressure (two equivalent forms, consistent)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A8-pstar}
p^{\star} \;=\; p_L + \rho_L (u_L - S_L)(u_L - S_{\star}) \;=\; p_R + \rho_R (u_R - S_R)(u_R - S_{\star})
\end{equation}

% Star densities
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A8-rhostar}
\rho^{\star}_L \;=\; \rho_L\,\frac{S_L - u_L}{S_L - S_{\star}}, \qquad \rho^{\star}_R \;=\; \rho_R\,\frac{S_R - u_R}{S_R - S_{\star}}
\end{equation}

% Star momenta
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A8-momstar}
(\rho u)^{\star}_K \;=\; \rho^{\star}_K\,S_{\star}, \qquad (\rho v)^{\star}_K \;=\; \rho^{\star}_K\,v_K \qquad\text{for } K \in \{L, R\}
\end{equation}

% Star energies
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A8-Estar}
E^{\star}_K \;=\; \rho^{\star}_K\,\left[\,\frac{E_K}{\rho_K} + (S_{\star} - u_K)\left(S_{\star} + \frac{p_K}{\rho_K\,(S_K - u_K)}\right)\right] \qquad K \in \{L, R\}
\end{equation}

% HLLC flux, piecewise by subsonic branch
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A8-HLLC}
F^{\mathrm{HLLC}} \;=\; \begin{cases}\mathbf{F}_L & 0 \le S_L, \\[2pt]\mathbf{F}_L + S_L (\mathbf{U}^{\star}_L - \mathbf{U}_L) & S_L \le 0 \le S_{\star}, \\[2pt]\mathbf{F}_R + S_R (\mathbf{U}^{\star}_R - \mathbf{U}_R) & S_{\star} \le 0 \le S_R, \\[2pt]\mathbf{F}_R & S_R \le 0.\end{cases}
\end{equation}
